paragraphs: Momentus Technologies sells event and venue management software, which the company says organizations use to increase bookings, streamline event operations, and improve venue revenue. One product line, Momentus Enterprise, is described for corporate campuses, universities, and convention centers. A second, Momentus Elite, is described for performing arts centers, stadiums, arenas, and conference centers.

The homepage states that more than 700 performing arts centers, theaters, museums, and cultural centers use the venue management software. It cites over 550 stadiums and arenas globally for the stadium and arena event management software. More than 85% of the largest convention centers in the world are described as managing scheduling, operations, and exhibitions on the platform. The same page counts more than 175 higher education institutions as users of the college and university event management software.

In January 2023, Ungerboeck rebranded to Momentus Technologies to unify the organization and its vertical-specific software, the company page states. The same page says the company has empowered 60,000 users in thousands of venues worldwide over more than 30 years. It ties that rebrand to the acquisitions of EventBooking, Priava, Showorks and Risk Manager two years prior.
